org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model

Class PupilWheel

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model.PupilWheel
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    DeviceStates

    @Entity
public class PupilWheel
extends Object
implements DeviceStates
    Instrument configuration Entity class representing the PupilWheel table. Transient fields for managing pupilMasks 1 through 6, and state related transient fields for the selected pupil mask and the pupil wheel state.
    Author:
    smichaels
